purpose: Verify that a host inhibitor blocks protected effects both before finalization and after an authenticated PASS decision but before effect execution.

expected.safe_condition: A valid inhibitor set before finalize must produce BLOCKED, and an inhibitor set after a finalized PASS must invalidate that PASS before effect execution; an uninhibited control may proceed.

limits: This test measures the MGnarf v1.70 in-process inhibitor path at the exact target commit.
It does not prove that an external human or policy system will always deliver a stop signal to the trusted host before the effect is consumed.
